scope: Catalogue items whose release date had only month or year precision (50 items).
rule: A date is applied only for the market its source names; a debut or availability date, never a production date, never borrowed from another language. An unsuccessful search establishes no absence.

findings.label: ko S-P 101 Snorlax non-holo
